'''I Variation''' is a rare variation of an original entity that has an '''I''' after its name. An example is [[A-20]], where its variation is [[A-20i]] which can rarely appear. However, the [[Red Rooms]] can change these types of entities' behavior, where [[A-20i]] replaces [[A-20]] entirely in the these rooms.
